title.narrative: Emergency Nutrition Programme by Humanitarian Coalition

description.narrative: This humanitarian program is proposing to both assist the population with emergency intervention in acute nutrition crisis and address consequences of nutrition crisis in areas identified by the Consortium where a multi-year approach could improve the nutrition and health status of children under the age of five as well as pregnant and lactating women.
